signature.name: VTask.IsEquivalent
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {E' : Type u_6} -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup E'] -> (l : Filter α) -> (u v : α → E') -> Prop

conventions.statement: When v is eventually zero along l, VTask.IsEquivalent l u v holds vacuously for any u, because IsLittleO of the zero function is trivially satisfied.
conventions.note: Degenerate case: the condition loses its usual meaning of 'same leading order'.

conventions.statement: When l is the bottom filter, VTask.IsEquivalent l u v holds for all u and v, since every eventual property is trivially satisfied.
conventions.note: Standard degenerate filter convention inherited from IsLittleO.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {E' : Type*} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E'] (l : Filter α) (u : α → E'), VTask.IsEquivalent l u u
